resources.string: Reads the package name of the app currently in the foreground, so Thermal Guardian Pro can detect games more accurately and in real time than the dumpsys-based fallback. Does not read screen content, text, or any personal data.

1. Tap the button below to open Accessibility Settings.\n2. Find \"Thermal Guardian Pro - Companion\" and turn it on.\n3. Done - the Thermal Guardian Pro module will automatically use this data once it is available.
